properties.value: <policies><inbound><authentication-managed-identity resource="https://cognitiveservices.azure.com" output-token-variable-name="managed-id-access-token" ignore-error="false" /><set-header name="Authorization" exists-action="override"><value>@("Bearer " + (string)context.Variables["managed-id-access-token"])</value></set-header><set-variable name="retryCount" value="@(0)" /><set-backend-service backend-id="gpt41-east" /></inbound><backend><retry condition="@(context.Response.StatusCode == 429)" count="1" interval="0" first-fast-retry="true"><choose><when condition="@((int)context.Variables["retryCount"] > 0)"><set-backend-service backend-id="gpt41-west" /></when></choose><set-variable name="retryCount" value="@((int)context.Variables["retryCount"] + 1)" /><forward-request buffer-request-body="true" /></retry></backend><outbound><base /><set-header name="x-backend-region" exists-action="override"><value>@{ var url = context.Request.Url.ToString(); if (url.Contains("csavatar380-west")) { return "West"; } if (url.Contains("csavatar380")) { return "East"; } return "?"; }</value></set-header><set-header name="x-east-429" exists-action="override"><value>@( ((int)context.Variables["retryCount"] > 1) ? "true" : "false" )</value></set-header><set-header name="x-retry-count" exists-action="override"><value>@( ((int)context.Variables["retryCount"]).ToString() )</value></set-header><set-header name="x-actual-url" exists-action="override"><value>@(context.Request.Url.ToString())</value></set-header></outbound><on-error><base /></on-error></policies>
